ranked.headline: Fused pretrained representations advance drug, protein and gene prediction
ranked.summary: Foundation models and multimodal fusion are now being benchmarked against specialized perturbation, drug-response and essentiality predictors.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings drive residue-level binding site prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs protein language model embeddings with graph and equivariant architectures to predict peptide, nucleic acid, and protein interface residues.

ranked.headline: Graph and generative models reconstruct and align spatial transcriptomic profiles
ranked.summary: A set of 2026 methods pairs spatial graphs, Gaussian processes, and cross-modal reference transfer to spatial and single-cell expression data.

ranked.headline: Population-scale inference of genomic variants from short, long and pangenome data
ranked.summary: Pangenome and long-read methods now genotype structural and rare variants across cattle, pig and human cohorts.

ranked.headline: ML methods integrate heterogeneous omics layers, handling missingness and confounding
ranked.summary: Recent work tackles missingness, batch effects and confounding in multi-omics models, with interpretability and external validation emphasized.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics methods infer regulatory networks, cell communication and metabolic programs
ranked.summary: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data now support dynamic, prior-informed regulatory network inference across tissues, cell states and disease contexts.

ranked.headline: Quantifying ligand binding free energy contributions with structure-aware methods
ranked.summary: Retrospective FEP+ validation at 1.06 kcal/mol RMSE and FragScan's per-fragment attribution sharpen quantitative affinity analysis for drug discovery.

ranked.headline: Allele-level states inferred directly from existing read-level sequencing data
ranked.summary: Per-read and per-allele counts already present in VCF and BAM outputs now support allele-level inference across tumor, spatial, and long-read data.

ranked.headline: LLM agents are being benchmarked on multistage biological data analysis tasks
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test whether AI agents can execute genomics and single-cell analyses, with best reported GeneBench-Pro pass rate at 31.5%.

ranked.headline: LLMs and literature mining attach mechanistic and contextual meaning to human genes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply LLM extraction and retrieval to gene-level annotation, linking genes to pathways, drugs, and enrichment results.

ranked.headline: Deep learning maps molecular readouts from histology, imaging and spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Deep models now infer cell- and coordinate-resolved molecular states from histology, microscopy, and spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve DNA methylation and regulatory elements at finer scales
ranked.summary: Phasing-free allele-specific methylation calling, replicate-aware DMR detection, and long-read repeat profiling are emerging together across preprints and…

ranked.headline: Benchmarked validation of microbiome computational tools improves output reliability
ranked.summary: Upstream microbiome analysis stages are increasingly checked with explicit benchmarks before downstream biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: DNA and protein language models tested on tokenization, pretraining, and pooling choices
ranked.summary: Recent studies benchmark tokenization, pretraining, and pooling choices in genomic and protein language models alongside deployable embedding tools.

ranked.headline: Read-level modeling refines transcript boundaries and RNA processing sites
ranked.summary: Updatable transcript definitions and read-class-aware analyses address measurement limits in direct, strand-specific, and single-cell RNA sequencing.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models map genomic sequences to RNA, variant, and editing outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent papers pair sequence-based deep learning with long-read sequencing and CRISPR-Cas9 tasks, while testing whether models capture the DNA features they…

ranked.headline: Learned models move protein prediction from single structures to dynamic ensembles
ranked.summary: Physics-aware deep learning is now used to recover alternative conformations, dynamics and measurement-consistent ensembles from structural data.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer RNA regulation and decay from sequence and transcriptomic features
ranked.summary: Interpretable and transformer-based models now link RNA sequence and transcript features to NMD sensitivity, splicing estimates and miRNA interactions.

ranked.headline: Strict splits and negative data quality reshape TCR and antibody binding prediction
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of structure predictors and generative models now test strict splits, negative data quality, and confidence metrics for TCR and antibody binding.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings separate shared and omics-specific structure in multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell and spatial multi-omics methods address integration, clustering and geometry-aware embedding of heterogeneous measurements, with a focus on…

ranked.headline: Gene flow and coalescent variance complicate phylogenetic topology inference
ranked.summary: Recent papers quantify how gene flow, coalescent variance, and asymmetric dependence distort topology, marker, and transmission inference.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic and generative models link single-cell immune data to response prediction
ranked.summary: Single-cell immune datasets now support explicit dynamic, repertoire, and cell-number modeling that predicts intervention outcomes.

ranked.headline: Deep learning with FDR-controlled atlases advances PTM peptide identification
ranked.summary: Harmonised public datasets and transfer learning now extend deep models to under-characterised PTMs and open search.

ranked.headline: Effective descriptions of birth-death, epidemic and replicator dynamics across biology
ranked.summary: Four July 2026 preprints reduce stochastic birth-death, epidemic, and replicator dynamics to tractable effective descriptions.

ranked.headline: Tool benchmarking and reproducible workflows for read mapping and single-cell analysis
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and packaged pipelines report accuracy, runtime, energy and resource use across sequencing and single-cell tools.

ranked.headline: MD-derived energetics and persistence metrics probe ligand discrimination and binding
ranked.summary: Simulation-derived energetics and persistence metrics now separate agonist from antagonist binding and test decomposed energy term reliability.

ranked.headline: Reference genomes for non-model taxa: tapeworm, lobster, and lanternfish assemblies
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies now extend to sex-chromosome systems, applied diagnostics, and immune gene evolution in taxa outside model systems.

ranked.headline: Computational structure models probe aquaporin, LRP1 glycan, and HLA-peptide biology
ranked.summary: Modeling and simulation now reach membrane channels, glycoprotein assemblies, and immune peptide presentation, systems that are hard to characterize directly.

ranked.headline: Metabolic models gain thermodynamic, kinetic, and community-scale constraints
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend genome-scale metabolic models with thermodynamic, kinetic, and community-level constraints.

ranked.headline: Encoding biological priors into graph, clock, and metabolic models
ranked.summary: Preprints and one published study pair network structure, transcript damage, and TF binding with predictive models of aging and metabolism.

ranked.headline: Compressed-space indexes and k-mer dictionaries for pangenome-scale sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Pangenome-scale data increasingly demands indexes that operate on compressed representations rather than expanded sequence.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and mechanistic models validated on trial, patient and screen data
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and hybrid models are now being checked against clinical trial, patient and screen outcomes to test dosing and protocol decisions.

ranked.headline: Scalable algorithms for repetitive and graph-structured genomic data inference
ranked.summary: Recent methods target scalable inference from repetitive sequences, pangenome graphs, phylogenetic networks, and metagenomic Hi-C contact graphs at genome…

ranked.headline: Software for simulating, visualizing and benchmarking ancestral recombination graphs
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair spatiotemporal ARG simulation with GPU-scale interactive rendering and simulation-based benchmarking of graph construction.

ranked.headline: Packaged tools make differential omics analyses reproducible and shareable
ranked.summary: Recent releases package differential and multi-omics workflows as reproducible, shareable software for proteomics, DamID and integrated omics data.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links duplication dynamics with convergent adaptation in animals
ranked.summary: Newly assembled long-read and reference genomes now enable cross-species tests of duplication retention and convergent selection.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools make proprietary and high-dimensional imaging data routinely usable
ranked.summary: Recent releases target format interoperability, streaming access to large images, and publication-ready figure generation.

ranked.headline: G-quadruplex motif symmetry and mutational effects on MYC promoter conformation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications refine G4 sequence-symmetry descriptors and nucleic acid backbone geometry models for DNA structure analysis.

ranked.headline: Contiguous chromosome-scale reference genome assemblies across eukaryotic lineages
ranked.summary: Contiguous assemblies now span an endangered Galapagos plant, a halophilic protist, and Heliconius butterflies, expanding available reference resources.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic lineage and trajectory models link cell fate and epigenetic state inference
ranked.summary: Recent methods couple lineage topology and stochastic dynamics to sparse readouts, extending trajectory inference to DNA methylation aging.
